title: Reticle Inspection - Mounds Detection on 5D Analyzer
subtitle: Pre-Diffusion Quality Validation for 22nm Node Manufacturing
author: Maria Gonzalez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the 5D Analyzer system to detect and classify Mounds defects during pre-diffusion inspection at the 22nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Mounds defects that are critical to yield at the 22nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the 5D Analyzer platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: 5D Analyzer
- Inspection Type: Reticle Inspection
- Target Defect: Mounds
- Process Step: Pre-Diffusion
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 22nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all 5D Analyzer systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for pre-diffusion monitoring in the 22nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: 5D Analyzer
Software Version: v11.8.667
Recipe: RETICLE_INSPECTION_22nm_PRE_DIFFUSION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (124 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.1μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the 5D Analyzer system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Reticle Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Mounds defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 22nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 51 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 97% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.5% for Reticle Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.96 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-06-26
Wafers Tested: 25
Total Defects Found: 2687
Defect Density: 855.3 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 2.8%
Capture Rate: 95.5%
Test Duration: 47 minutes
System Uptime: 96.3%

Result Classification: FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The 5D Analyzer demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Mounds at the 22nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) The system successfully integrated with the factory automation host.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Re-tune detection algorithm thresholds for Mounds at 22nm node.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Escalate to R&D for algorithm enhancement if re-tuning does not resolve sensitivity gap.
